content: Fronthaul network architecture diagram showing 5G core, distributed units, fast optical switches, and 6G devices via Ethernet and Fronthaul networks

```mermaid
graph TD
    A["Open TimeCard"] --> B["GNSS Receiver"]
    B --> C["PPS"]
    C --> D["High stability oscillator"]
    D --> E["Time Synchronisation and Distribution"]
    E --> F["IEEE 1588"]
    F --> G["PPS 10 MHz"]
    G --> H["Single Board Computer"]
    H --> I["Timed Controlling Agent"]
    I --> J["FPGA and Switch Driver"]
    J --> K["FPGA"]
    K --> L["Optical Switch"]
    L --> M["Real/Non-real time telemetry"]
    M --> H
    style A fill:#f9f,stroke:#333
    style H fill:#bbf,stroke:#333
    style J fill:#dfd,stroke:#333
    style K fill:#dfd,stroke:#333
```
